summary: The general deontic language and algebra: the three modal operators (O/P/F), the eight Hohfeldian incidents, a grammar for a deontic statement, the formula representation, and the composition algebra a reasoner combines with governance and other languages. Pure language, no inference.
operator_note: One primitive (O); F≡O¬ and P≡¬O¬ are its duals. "Right" is not a modality — it is a Hohfeldian incident (claim / privilege).

algebra.carrier: deontic formulae over a proposition; the eight Hohfeld incidents
laws: operator clash (O/F, F/P over same bearer+action)

well_formedness: operator is one of O, P, F
bearer and action are non-empty (a grounded formula also cites its source sentence)
incident, when present, is one of the eight Hohfeld positions; '' is abstention
a rendered formula parses back to the same structured statement (round-trip)
